thread:
Alex (AE): Hey team — Crescent Fin POC kickoff. They need SSO (SAML), SCIM user/group provisioning, RBAC scoped by domain, and domain ownership verification. Also want Dedicated pricing and ETA for security questionnaire answers.
Maria (SE): Do we have their IdP type?
Tony (Crescent Fin): We're on Okta (orgwide), multiple domains (crescent.com + partners.crescent.com). Prefer SP-initiated SSO.
Raj (Solutions Eng): SP-initiated Okta is fine. We'll need ACS URL, EntityID, metadata, and NameID format (email vs persistent). For RBAC, do they want role claims or SCIM group mapping?
Tony (Crescent Fin): We'll push groups from Okta via SCIM.
Maria (SE): SCIM push is supported. Notes: we support full-sync and incremental PATCH. Very large groups may need pagination tuning.
Sylvie (Security): We'll need their SAML metadata, cert rotation policy, SCIM over TLS confirmation, and domain verification method (DNS TXT or verified email). Any compliance flags?
Tony (Crescent Fin): No external regs, internal policy requires cert rotation every 90 days and tenant isolation. Domain binding: users with crescent.com must map to tenant A.
Raj (Solutions Eng): We can do email-domain -> tenant mapping via routing rules. For users with multiple verified domains, map to primary unless org attribute present.
Maria (SE): POC plan: 1) exchange SAML metadata, 2) enable SCIM with test Okta app, 3) push groups and verify RBAC mapping, 4) test domain-claim flows. Drafting config snippet now:
```
# sample SAML settings
acs_url: https://api.redwood-inference.com/saml/acs
entity_id: https://redwood-inference.com/saml/sp
nameid_format: email
```
Tony (Crescent Fin): Good. How long for Dedicated pricing?
Alex (AE): Preliminary quote 4 hours — 6-month reserved pool + estimated throughput.
Sylvie (Security): I'll take the questionnaire once Tony uploads it. Return annotated in 48 hours.
infra-bot: Helpful docs: https://docs.redwood.com/sso/scim and https://docs.redwood.com/dedicated/pricing
Raj (Solutions Eng): Note: Okta sometimes sends groups as SAML claims vs SCIM deltas. We'll test both and ensure idempotent group mapping.
Tony (Crescent Fin): We'll start SCIM push. Also need session timeout control and SLO behavior documented.
Maria (SE): Session TTL and single logout supported; I'll document cookie/session lifetimes in the runbook.
Alex (AE): Action items: Alex -> pricing (4h); Maria -> POC runbook + checklist; Sylvie -> security review (48h); Raj -> test plan for large-group sync. Tony -> share Okta metadata + questionnaire.
Tony (Crescent Fin): Sharing metadata and questionnaire by EOD. Thanks. :thumbsup:
Maria (SE): Scheduling 30m kickoff tomorrow.
Raj (Solutions Eng): Standing by for Okta app access.
Alex (AE): Thanks all. Keeping thread here for updates. :rocket:
